body:
Update railDensity in packages/model-router/lib/density.mjs so non-code config and documentation paths in ticket.scope do not dilute railDensity below the floor when code scope paths exist.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Non-code scope patterns (config, markdown, lockfiles, workflows, changelogs) are excluded from the denominator when code scope patterns are present. Verify: node --test packages/model-router/test/model-router.test.mjs
2. When a ticket scope consists exclusively of non-code patterns, railDensity falls back to the full usable scope count. Verify: node --test packages/model-router/test/model-router.test.mjs
title: model-router: exclude non-code config and doc paths from railDensity denominator (#1184)
